newsitem.title: THAILAND: Canada signs C$1 bln business deals in Thailand.
newsitem.headline: Canada signs C$1 bln business deals in Thailand.

text.p: The Canadian government and businessmen have signed 55 deals worth over C$1 billion in Thailand, a government statement said on Friday.

"The business deals signed in Thailand include C$614.09 million in commercial contracts and C$407.74 million in agreements in principle, including memoranda of understanding and letters of intent," said the statement released in conjunction with Canadia Prime Minister Jean Chretien's four-day visit.
